text_block_list.text:
Though we have reached the three-year milestone—
some everyday routines never change.
I decided to head over to the Academy's fields today as well.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's you! Putting in hard work again today, I see!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Almost all the vegetables across the academy were harvested during the event the other day.
So we're starting over from sowing seeds."

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Mm. Accompanying them with patience and sincerity.
That is what it means to nurture.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, you know. Even if you do the same job as always,
the results can turn out completely different."

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
In the beginning, all are the same seed.
As long as you prepare a fertile ground,
they will eventually sprout into magnificent blossoms.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: And—before long, it will bear fruit of all shapes and colors. Each one wonderfully unique and magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"I fully intend to keep going on forever and ever!
As long as there are those striving to grow!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
—Huh!?
The Chairwoman and Trainer are already here!?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: "Whoa, whoa, for real?! So neither Spe nor I managed to be the first one here today, huh?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I'll work as hard as I can to make up for running late~!
I gotta prepare some nice, fluffy soil for the veggies!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, Chairwoman, everyone.
There are a few new vegetables
I'd like to try growing, would that be okay...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, actually Rice was thinking it's about time too...!
Is it... okay...?"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Go right ahead
and pursue every possibility!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
What you choose to sprout is up to you!
It is entirely... up to your own free will!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—All riiight, everyone!
Let's get started today too~!
